description_en: Configures a Layer 7 certificate for a specified domain name
description_zh: 调用ConfigLayer7Cert为指定域名配置7层证书
name: ConfigLayer7Cert

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The certificate ID. 

If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify CertName, Cert, or Key
parameters.help_zh:
证书ID。 

若传入此参数，则无需传入CertName、Cert、Key
parameters.name: cert_id

parameters.help_en:
The certificate name. 

If you specify this parameter, you must also specify Cert and Key. If you specify the CertName, Cert, and Key combination, you do not need to specify CertId
parameters.help_zh:
证书名称。 

若传入此参数，则必须同时传入Cert和Key。若传入CertName、Cert、Key组合，则无需传入CertId
parameters.name: cert_name

parameters.help_en:
The certificate public key. 

If you specify this parameter, you must also specify CertName and Key. If you specify the CertName, Cert, and Key combination, you do not need to specify CertId
parameters.help_zh:
证书公钥。 

若传入此参数，则必须同时传入CertName和Key。若传入CertName、Cert、Key组合，则无需传入CertId
parameters.name: cert

parameters.help_en:
The certificate private key. 

If you specify this parameter, you must also specify CertName and Cert. If you specify the CertName, Cert, and Key combination, you do not need to specify CertId
parameters.help_zh:
证书私钥。 

若传入此参数，则必须同时传入CertName和Cert。若传入CertName、Cert、Key组合，则无需传入CertId
parameters.name: key
